issues.title: Incorrect Heading Hierarchy
issues.description: Page does not contain an h1 heading but contains h2 or subheadings: [h2]
issues.expectedBehavior: Page should start with a single h1 heading tag for search engine optimization and screen reader readability.
issues.actualBehavior: Page starts with heading level tags: [h2] without h1 root.
issues.suggestedFix: Wrap page title in an <h1> element or adjust subheading tags accordingly.
